description: The bio page's visits and taps by day, for the last `days` days, broken down by link (default), source app, day, post or spot. By link, compare vs_spot rather than raw taps: higher spots get more taps whatever the link, so vs_spot says how a link does for where it sits, and chance_better how sure that is. Act only on links without too_few_visits. source narrows everything to visitors from one app. next_steps points at bio_suggest for ranked changes from these numbers: its apply is the exact call to make (tool and input).

source.description: Only visitors from this app (from the address's ?s= tag, the in-app browser or the referrer)

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: bio_insights_get
title: Link page numbers
